title: Fix a leaking pipe joint
instructions: Show the water being shut off, then fix a leaking pipe joint and explain each step out loud.

criteria.text: Water supply is shut off before work starts
The joint is cleaned and the old sealant is removed
Thread tape or sealant is applied correctly
The joint is tightened firmly without over-tightening
The fix is tested for leaks at the end
The worker explains each step in their own words
